about: Golden answers for the whole answer pipeline (Phase 4). Every question has a REFERENCE answer, the FACTS a correct answer must contain (alternatives separated by ' || '), and the gold SOURCES: a list of groups - for each group, one chunk from any of its (file, phrase) alternatives must be found. Unanswerable questions have forbidden_terms: words that must NOT appear anywhere in the documents (checked by a test, so a new document can never silently make a question answerable). Written by hand by the project author, who also wrote the documents: expect some bias.
